instructionsMarkdown:
# Flask 3+ Modular Microservice Architecture

Architect modular, testable Python web services following Flask Application Factory and Blueprint conventions.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Always instantiate the app using the Application Factory pattern (`create_app()`).
- Decompose distinct domain boundaries into isolated `Blueprint` modules.
- Ensure database sessions are automatically cleaned up in `@app.teardown_appcontext`.
- Validate incoming JSON bodies using `Pydantic` models before business logic dispatch.
